profile.input_contract: OpenMC-compatible pincell case parameters and material perturbation fields.
profile.output_contract: Parsed OpenMC output/tally metrics such as k_eff and tally means.
profile.adapter: OpenMC Python runner plus input/output adapters under SUT/openmc/.
profile.dependency_risk: requires OpenMC Python environment; skipped when unavailable

mrs.description: Monte Carlo counterpart of the OpenMOC ScaleNuSigmaF MR. Scaling the fuel material's nu-sigma-f cross section by factor > 1 must monotonically increase k_eff in OpenMC's multi-group eigenvalue solve, just as it does in OpenMOC's deterministic transport solve. Same MR, different solver.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Mono MR: Monte Carlo counterpart of the OpenMOC ScaleNuSigmaF MR.
explanation_profile.transformation_semantics: Apply ScaleNuSigmaF via transform steps [ScaleField@/materials/fuel/nu_sigma_f] to derive follow-up input while preserving unrelated fields.
explanation_profile.observable_summary: Observe `k_eff` from source and follow-up outputs for MR `openmc-pincell-nu-sigma-f`.
explanation_profile.predicate_summary: Predicate `greater` / `GreaterThan` checks the expected relation on `k_eff`.
explanation_profile.tolerance_summary: Ordinal predicate: no numeric tolerance is applied beyond the declared ordering relation.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable when SUT `openmc` exposes sample `sample/pincell.json`, the transform target fields, and output `k_eff`; otherwise not applicable.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure indicates the SUT output, adapter mapping, or predicate evidence disagrees with the declared metamorphic expectation.

mrs.description: Same physical input on both sides; the follow-up case multiplies OpenMC's `particles` count by factor > 1. By the Monte-Carlo 1/√N sampling law the reported k_eff_std must shrink to ~ 1/√factor of the source value. The variance-ratio assertion permits a (1 + ToleranceRel) relative slack above the expected ratio to absorb finite-sample noise.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Conv MR: Same physical input on both sides; the follow-up case multiplies OpenMC's `particles` count by factor > 1.
explanation_profile.transformation_semantics: Apply ScaleField via transform steps [ScaleField@/solver/particles] to derive follow-up input while preserving unrelated fields.
explanation_profile.observable_summary: Observe `k_eff_std` from source and follow-up outputs for MR `openmc-pincell-particle-count-convergence`.
explanation_profile.predicate_summary: Predicate `variance-ratio` / `VarianceRatio` checks the expected relation on `k_eff_std`.
explanation_profile.tolerance_summary: Noise-aware comparison using multiplier 1.0 and declared runtime noise model.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable when SUT `openmc` exposes sample `sample/pincell.json`, the transform target fields, and output `k_eff_std`; otherwise not applicable.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure indicates the SUT output, adapter mapping, or predicate evidence disagrees with the declared metamorphic expectation.
